title: manifest.jsonl — court record (Indian Kanoon / external eCourts)
description: One court document acquired for litigation-adjacent research. `provider` discriminates the two sources, and they are NOT interchangeable. `indiankanoon` rows come from api.indiankanoon.org, a paid commercial index (queries leave the org) reimplemented from the MIT-licensed IKAPI wire contract; `docid` is Indian Kanoon's own id and `url` its public permalink. `ecourts` rows come from a separately installed GPL-3.0 executable invoked across a process boundary — never imported or bundled, because commoner-probe ships MIT — and its fields are carried verbatim under `raw` with `raw_sha256` over the canonical JSON, because this repo has not verified that tool's output shape and will not invent a mapping for it. A court record is retrieval, not legal advice: nothing here interprets the judgment.
